_meta.name: ETF holdings — State Controller / RPTTF / CDE Interim apportionment-intercept activity scoring
_meta.purpose: Score the 9 ETF holdings (6 CA K-12 USDs subject to dedicated-tax GO masking, 3 CA Successor RDA TAB obligors) for State-Controller / County-Auditor / DOF / CDE apportionment-activity in the trailing 12 months. Detector severity: HIGH on interruption (ROPS bond-debt denied, NEGATIVE certification, withholding); MEDIUM on modification (QUALIFIED certification, ROPS partial denial of non-debt items); LOW on routine.
_meta.channel_taxonomy_note: Three structurally distinct intercept channels are reduced to a single detector via the intercept_type field — do not silently merge: (a) lcff = SCO LCFF apportionment to charter trustee under Ed Code 17199.4 (CSFA-issued charter conduit only); (b) cde_interim = CDE Interim Status Report Qualified/Negative certification of K-12 districts (signals operating-side IDR risk; K-12 dedicated-tax GO bonds are NOT paid by SCO — county tax collector flows direct to trustee under SB 222 statutory lien); (c) rpttf = DOF approval + County Auditor-Controller distribution of RPTTF to successor agency TAB trustee under HSC 34183. None of the 6 K-12 USDs here are CSFA charter conduits; all 6 are USD GO obligors, so the cde_interim channel is the appropriate signal source.
data_quality_caveats: No SCO direct apportionment-withholding events found for any of the 9 holdings — SCO does not publish per-LEA per-month payment audit feeds in machine-readable form within current scoping. CDE Interim Status Report and DOF ROPS review letters are the relied-on primary channels.

For the 6 K-12 USDs: trailing-12mo CDE Interim Status Reports checked were FY 2024-25 First Interim (added March 2025), FY 2024-25 Second Interim (added May 2, 2025), and FY 2025-26 First Interim (added March 2, 2026). FY 2025-26 Second Interim not yet published as of 2026-05-28.

For the 3 Successor Agencies: DOF ROPS review letters for ROPS 24-25 (annual period 2024-07 to 2025-06) and ROPS 25-26 (annual period 2025-07 to 2026-06) were checked. The ROPS 25-26 letters all approved bond-debt service in full. ROPS 24-25 letters were not re-pulled — assumed clean per absence of follow-on litigation news.

All 9 holdings show approved-in-full distributions in the trailing 12mo. Only 1 modification event detected (River Delta Joint USD Qualified Certification, FY 2025-26 First Interim) — fires the detector at MEDIUM severity for that single name.
_meta.verifier_pass: HOSTILE — explicitly checked each named holding for: (1) ROPS bond-debt-service denial; (2) NEGATIVE certification; (3) intercept-channel mismatch (e.g., assuming SCO LCFF intercept applies to K-12 USD GO when it does not); (4) reliance on stale data. Failed assumptions corrected: original task spec premise that 'check whether SB 222 dedicated-tax bonds also have SCO intercept layer' — FALSIFIED. SB 222 does NOT add an SCO intercept; it codifies a county-level statutory lien on the dedicated tax. No SCO channel applies to K-12 USD GO debt service.

holdings.obligor_name: River Delta Joint Unified School District
holdings.structural_pledge: K-12 USD GO — dedicated property tax under SB 222 statutory lien (Cal. Gov't Code §53515). County tax collector flows tax directly to bond trustee; SCO has no debt-service role.

interruption_or_modification_events.description: CDE FY 2025-26 First Interim Status Report — River Delta Joint Unified listed with Qualified Certification (district may not meet financial obligations for FY 2025-26, 2026-27, or 2027-28). $40.9M budget. Entry #23 on qualified list. Verified-new event: River Delta was NOT listed in FY 2024-25 First Interim, NOT listed in FY 2024-25 Second Interim.

CDE FY 2025-26 Second Interim Status Report — River Delta Joint Unified again listed with Qualified Certification. $40.0M budget. Entry #14. BACK-TO-BACK QUALIFIED on consecutive cycles is the canonical pre-receivership trajectory pattern (Sacramento City USD 2024-25 Q → 2025-26 N → April 2026 BB- + $170M deficit; Vallejo USD Q for 5+ years before 2004 state takeover).

holdings.credit_implication: Back-to-back Qualified certification (FY 2025-26 First + Second Interim, only 84 days apart) is the canonical pre-receivership trajectory pattern. Under the verified ca_k12_dedicated_tax_special_revenue mechanism, dedicated-tax GO bond pledge is structurally insulated from district operating cash flow — county tax collector flows direct to trustee. HOWEVER, sustained operating distress drives IDR cuts, and Fitch criteria allow dedicated-tax GO ratings up to 5 notches above IDR — so a Sacramento-USD-style trajectory (IDR cut from A+ → BB-) could compress dedicated-tax GO from AAA → BBB+ over 6-18 months. River Delta is small (~$40M budget) so timing uncertain but back-to-back Q makes IDR-cut probability elevated. Parallel detector coe_fiscal_certification rates this HIGH severity on the back-to-back pattern; this detector rates MEDIUM under intercept-activity taxonomy (no actual SCO/county-auditor payment interruption yet observed).
holdings.etf_action: FLAG — confirm whether ETF holding is dedicated-tax GO (likely retains AAA-AA+ within 5-notch ceiling) vs ULTGO or COP (full IDR exposure). On dedicated-tax GO, no immediate exclusion; monitor for FY 2026-27 First Interim (Dec 2026) and any IDR-action news. On ULTGO/COP, recommend trim/exit — pre-receivership trajectory + appropriation paper = no structural insulation.

summary.structural_finding: The original task hypothesis that 'SB 222 dedicated-tax bonds also have SCO intercept layer' is FALSIFIED. SB 222 (Cal. Gov't Code §53515) codifies a county-level statutory lien on the dedicated property tax; the State Controller has no role in K-12 USD GO debt service. The relevant state-actor channel for K-12 USD holdings is the CDE Interim Status Report (Qualified / Negative certification), which signals operating-side fiscal distress that may transmit to IDR within 6-18 months and compress dedicated-tax GO via the Fitch 5-notch ceiling. For Successor RDA TABs, DOF + County Auditor-Controller is the canonical channel; SCO is not involved.
